_comment: Challenge scenarios (title screen → Challenges) and the daily run. start: cash, reputation, building (premises id), fixtures (extra equipment types, laid out by the level), staff [{role, level}], stock [{seller, models, count, quality, state: untested|graded}] (left on pallets in goods-in, already paid for), parts {part id: n}, consumables, items [{kind, slot}] (slot may use {fixture_type} = the first extra fixture of that type), licences [ids]. rules: no_staff (hiring is blocked). goal.kind: process (every unit of the starting stock graded, sold or recycled), building (reach premises tier), profit (cash gained since the start), cash (balance), ship (orders shipped), score_profit / score_ship (no target — the score when the days run out). days = working-day limit. medals: for target goals the day you finish by (lower is better); for score goals the score you need (higher is better). Local records live in user://challenge_records.json, one board per challenge (CHALLENGE_<ID>) and per daily run (DAILY_<yyyymmdd>), ready for Steam leaderboards.

challenges.name: The council refresh
challenges.desc: Thornbury Borough Council has dumped its whole three-year laptop refresh on you: 200 laptops on pallets in the yard, all needing testing, wiping and grading before the council's auditors visit. You've got the industrial unit, a network test rack, a network imaging rack and a small crew.

challenges.name: Out of the garage
challenges.desc: The classic start with a little more in the bank. Earn the £10,000 removals and deposit and move into the railway-arch lock-up before your uncle wants his garage back.

challenges.name: Lone wolf
challenges.desc: No staff. No help. Just you (and your mates in co-op), a lock-up with two test benches and a decent reputation. Make £3,000 profit.

challenges.name: Overdraft escape
challenges.desc: You bought one lot too many. You're £300 overdrawn, the bank is twitchy and there are 24 untested laptops on the drive. Turn them into £2,000 in the bank.

challenges.name: Flogit frenzy
challenges.desc: Thirty graded laptops are already listed and your reputation is up. The orders are about to pour in: pack them, get them on the courier shelf, and keep the pipeline fed. Ship 40 orders.

challenges.name: Deadline night
challenges.desc: Swiftline Couriers want 40 laptops processed by Thursday and you've only got the garage. You do have a night shift licence, a second test bench and one tester. Keep the lights on.

daily._comment: The daily run: the same seed and start for everyone on a given (UTC) date, one attempt per day. The date seeds which variant, premises, cash, reputation and starting stock you get; medals scale with the premises (medal_mult).

variants.name: Profit sprint
variants.desc: Make as much profit as you can in five working days. Score = cash gained since the start.

variants.name: Dispatch dash
variants.desc: Ship as many orders as you can in five working days. Score = orders shipped.
